summary.text: Mira Tanner-Hughes is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 65, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community volunteer and board member of the Appalachian Mutual Aid Collective.

paragraphs.text: Tanner-Hughes graduated from Buckhannon-Upshur High School and attended West Virginia Wesleyan College and Southern New Hampshire University.
Her career experience includes customer service work.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 12, 2026, and faces incumbent Republican Carl Martin.
In the survey, Tanner-Hughes said she volunteers with the collective's Free Meals Appalachia program.
She listed stronger labor unions, ending food insecurity through government-owned grocery stores, and ending housing insecurity as her key messages.
